gloss: to raise (one's voice); to shout out

definitions.gloss: to raise one's voice; to shout out; to belt out
definitions.explanation: To produce a loud, forceful voice, straining it so that it carries. Almost always used with {声|こえ} as the object, describing shouting, calling out, or singing loudly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げた。
⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}よく→元気よく：23305_genkiyoku⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The shop staff are calling out energetically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げて⟦{歌|うた}っていた→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: The cheering squad sang at the top of their voices throughout the match.

notes:
Transitive verb, almost always taking ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ as its object: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げる (to raise one's voice). Implies a deliberate, forceful effort to be loud, often to be heard over noise or distance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げる: to raise one's voice; to shout
- ⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げる: to yell loudly
- ⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{張|は}り{上|あ}げる: to let out a scream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{叫|さけ}ぶ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧: to shout — focuses on the cry itself; {張|は}り{上|あ}げる stresses the effort of forcing the voice out
- ⟦{怒鳴|どな}る→怒鳴る：05340_donaru⟧: to yell (angrily) — usually carries anger, which {張|は}り{上|あ}げる does not
